entities.summary: Velké Losiny is a spa municipality and village in Šumperk District in the Olomouc Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 2,500 inhabitants. It is known for the Velké Losiny Castle and for the Paper Mill, which is a national cultural monument. Castle in Velké Losiny is a château from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
